description: This file defines a PHP class 'BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber' that subscribes to module status change events within the OrangeHRM system. It reacts specifically to changes involving the 'buzz' module, updating permissions for a related dashboard widget upon status change.

classes.name: BuzzModuleStatusChangeSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber class that listens for module status change events and updates widget permissions when the 'buzz' module status changes.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping the 'MODULE_STATUS_CHANGE' event to the handler method 'onStatusChangeEvent'.

methods.name: onStatusChangeEvent
methods.description: Handles a module status change event; if the 'buzz' module was previously active, updates the permissions for the 'dashboard_buzz_widget' according to the new module status.
